text:
alex.s: Hey team — handing off MistralGrid. Quick context: enterprise fintech, started pilot on hosted API, wants Dedicated capacity + SSO for production. Renewal in ~10mo, sales flagged potential budget freeze in Q3. Pilot metrics: ~95 RPS, expected growth to 400-600 RPS over 8–12 weeks. They need: 1) SSO (SAML) + JIT user provisioning, 2) dedicated pool sizing guidance, 3) enablement session for platform engineers, 4) runbook for on-call handoff. Contract has two minor custom clauses (see ticket).

alex.s: Primary contacts - customer: Priya Shah (APM), CTO: Marco Li. Sales owner: alex.s. Expected go-live target: 2026-06-15 (tentative).

maria_csm: Thanks @alex.s — taking primary CS ownership. I'll set initial 30/60/90 onboarding milestones and schedule the enablement. Can someone attach the contract redline?

alex.s: attaching link to contract redline and notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4127 (sales notes in comment). Also there is a small SSO exception request from their security team.

jordan_cs: I'll own enablement + runbook. Suggested owners: @maria_csm (CS overall lead), @sam_support (support contact), @ina_eng (engineering escalation). Proposed dates: kickoff 2026-04-28, technical deep dive 2026-05-05. Does that work?

sam_support: OK for support — I'll open a triage ticket for pre-prod incidents and capture contact rotations. Need to confirm whether they want incidents routed to Dedicated pool vs. fallback hosted.

ina_eng: @ina_eng here — engineering note: SAML SSO requires a minor IdP metadata parsing patch we rolled out last quarter; we'll need to enable compatibility flag and run a smoke test. ETA for patching their staging environment: 5 business days after we get metadata and test user accounts.

maria_csm: Action items so far: - collect SAML metadata (owner: alex.s / customer) - open onboarding runbook draft (owner: jordan_cs) - support triage ticket (owner: sam_support) - engineering compatibility check (owner: ina_eng) - contract exceptions review (owner: legal via alex.s). I'll create a central project board and invite all owners.

alex.s: I'll ping Priya today for metadata and ask legal to expedite exception review. Also FYI, customer is evaluating cost vs. quantization options — would like a short note on quant/profile recommendations for their workload.

ina_eng: For throughput, recommend starting with 8x A100 (dedicated pool) with batching policy: 
```
max_batch_size: 64
latency_slo_ms: 120
prefill_cache: true
```
We can tune after 2 weeks of production metrics. I'll draft a quantization note for the enablement.

sam_support: Added ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-8890 — pre-prod triage + escalation path. Please add on-call rotations.

handoff-bot: Reminder: new thread created for MistralGrid handoff. Please update the CS board card: https://redwood.atlassian.net/jira/software/projects/CS/boards/17

jordan_cs: I'll schedule the enablement invites and share the runbook draft by EOD Friday. For renewal risk: Maria — can you flag stakeholders to start quarterly business reviews after go-live? The budget freeze callout seems like a medium risk — we should lock in usage-based milestones to demonstrate value early.

maria_csm: Agreed. I'll set cadence: weekly onboarding check-ins until go-live, then monthly QBRs. I'll also capture baseline metrics to show ROI (latency, cost per 1k tokens, error rates).

alex.s: Thanks team — I'm available for the kickoff. If anything blocks metadata/legal I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

maria_csm: Next steps: everyone add checklist items to CS-4127 and confirm owners by EOD. I'll post the kickoff calendar invite once dates are confirmed. :calendar:
